Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Revenge of the Barbarians" has the younger director. This is a direct logical contradiction of the data gathered in previous steps. The conversation established that Scott Caan (Director of Dallas 362) was born in 1976, while Giuseppe Vari (Director of Revenge of the Barbarians) was born in either 1916 or 1924. Since 1976 is a later year than 1916 or 1924, Scott Caan is the younger director. The Planner failed to perform the correct chronological comparison (1976 > 1924) and instead reversed the conclusion, likely due to confusion regarding which director belonged to which film or a simple calculation error in the final synthesis step.
